#### Syntax Guide 
STM32CubeMX will override code not included in user code comment brackets when changes are made to the hardware/firmware configuration. 
*Please*, only include code in vendor generated files as shown: 
```
// User Code Begin --- // 

/* place your code here */

// User Code End --- //
```
